attempts.summary: On node1, created the datauser account and a dedicated XFS-backed loopback filesystem mounted at /srv/data (via /etc/fstab, options loop,pquota,prjquota). Set an XFS project quota hard limit of 100MB for datauser's project on /srv/data. Filesystem-level enforcement was verified both before and after a full node reboot: writes past 100MB fail with "No space left on device" and xfs_quota reports the 100M hard limit. Boot identity changed across the restart (boot_id 6aa805ba... -> d3dd7dfe...), and the mount, ownership, and quota all recovered automatically on boot.
